funcs.doc: BuildUptoPermit2SettleArgs converts a raw UptoPermit2Payload into typed contract-call arguments.

funcs.name: CheckUptoPermit2Prerequisites
funcs.doc: CheckUptoPermit2Prerequisites checks proxy deployment, payer token balance and payer ETH balance for gas.
funcs.signature:
func CheckUptoPermit2Prerequisites(
	ctx context.Context,
	signer evm.FacilitatorEvmSigner,
	tokenAddress string,
	payer string,
	amountRequired string,
) *x402.VerifyResponse

funcs.name: DiagnoseUptoPermit2SimulationFailure
funcs.doc:
DiagnoseUptoPermit2SimulationFailure runs a multicall diagnostic to return the most
specific error reason after an upto simulation failure.
funcs.signature:
func DiagnoseUptoPermit2SimulationFailure(
	ctx context.Context,
	signer evm.FacilitatorEvmSigner,
	tokenAddress string,
	permit2Payload *evm.UptoPermit2Payload,
	amountRequired string,
) *x402.VerifyResponse

funcs.name: SettleUptoPermit2
funcs.doc:
SettleUptoPermit2 settles an upto Permit2 payment by calling x402UptoPermit2Proxy.settle().
simulateInSettle controls whether to run an eth_call simulation as part of pre-settle verification.
funcs.signature:
func SettleUptoPermit2(
	ctx context.Context,
	signer evm.FacilitatorEvmSigner,
	payload types.PaymentPayload,
	requirements types.PaymentRequirements,
	permit2Payload *evm.UptoPermit2Payload,
	facilCtx *x402.FacilitatorContext,
	simulateInSettle bool,
) (*x402.SettleResponse, error)

funcs.name: SimulateUptoPermit2Settle
funcs.doc: SimulateUptoPermit2Settle runs settle() via eth_call (ReadContract) on the upto proxy.

funcs.name: SimulateUptoPermit2SettleWithPermit
funcs.doc: SimulateUptoPermit2SettleWithPermit runs settleWithPermit() via eth_call on the upto proxy.
funcs.signature:
func SimulateUptoPermit2SettleWithPermit(
	ctx context.Context,
	signer evm.FacilitatorEvmSigner,
	permit2Payload *evm.UptoPermit2Payload,
	settlementAmount *big.Int,
	eip2612Signature, eip2612Amount, eip2612DeadlineStr string,
) (bool, error)

funcs.name: VerifyUptoPermit2
funcs.doc:
VerifyUptoPermit2 verifies an upto Permit2 payment payload against the given requirements.
simulate controls whether to run an eth_call simulation as part of verification.
funcs.signature:
func VerifyUptoPermit2(
	ctx context.Context,
	signer evm.FacilitatorEvmSigner,
	payload types.PaymentPayload,
	requirements types.PaymentRequirements,
	permit2Payload *evm.UptoPermit2Payload,
	facilCtx *x402.FacilitatorContext,
	simulate bool,
) (*x402.VerifyResponse, error)

types.name: EIP2612PermitData
types.doc: EIP2612PermitData holds the parsed EIP-2612 permit fields for settleWithPermit() calls.
types.declaration:
type EIP2612PermitData struct {
	Value    *big.Int
	Deadline *big.Int
	R        [32]byte
	S        [32]byte
	V        uint8
}

types.name: UptoEvmScheme
types.doc:
UptoEvmScheme implements the SchemeNetworkFacilitator interface for EVM upto payments (V2).
Only supports Permit2 (no EIP-3009 path).

methods.name: CaipFamily
methods.doc: CaipFamily returns the CAIP family pattern this facilitator supports

methods.name: GetExtra
methods.doc:
GetExtra returns mechanism-specific extra data for the supported kinds endpoint.
For upto, returns the facilitatorAddress so clients include it in their signed witness.

methods.name: GetSigners
methods.doc: GetSigners returns signer addresses used by this facilitator.

methods.name: Settle
methods.doc: Settle settles a V2 upto payment on-chain.

methods.name: Verify
methods.doc: Verify verifies a V2 upto payment payload against requirements.

types.name: UptoEvmSchemeConfig
UptoPermit2SettleArgs
types.doc:
UptoPermit2SettleArgs holds the parsed and typed arguments for upto settle()/settleWithPermit().
Differs from exact: witness includes Facilitator, and settle takes a separate Amount.

Witness

funcs.name: MessageHash
funcs.doc:
MessageHash returns a stable, immutable cache key for a transaction by hashing its
message bytes. The fee-payer signature (slot 0) is mutable - the facilitator
overwrites it before broadcast - so keying on the full wire bytes would let an
attacker bypass deduplication by randomizing those bytes. The message is what
every signer commits to, so its hash uniquely and immutably identifies a payment.

FacilitatorSvmSigner defines facilitator operations for SVM
Supports multiple signers for load balancing, key rotation, and high availability
All implementation details (RPC clients, key management) are hidden

fields.name: GetAddresses
fields.doc:
GetAddresses returns all addresses this facilitator can use as fee payers for a network
Enables dynamic address selection for load balancing and key rotation

fields.name: SignTransaction
fields.doc:
SignTransaction signs a transaction with the signer matching feePayer
Transaction is modified in-place to add the facilitator's signature
Returns error if no signer exists for feePayer or signing fails
fields.type: func(ctx context.Context, tx *solana.Transaction, feePayer solana.PublicKey, network string) error

fields.name: SimulateTransaction
fields.doc:
SimulateTransaction simulates a signed transaction to verify it would succeed
Returns error if simulation fails
fields.type: func(ctx context.Context, tx *solana.Transaction, network string) error

fields.name: SendTransaction
fields.doc:
SendTransaction sends a signed transaction to the network
Returns transaction signature or error if send fails
fields.type: func(ctx context.Context, tx *solana.Transaction, network string) (solana.Signature, error)

fields.name: ConfirmTransaction
fields.doc:
ConfirmTransaction waits for transaction confirmation
Returns error if confirmation fails or times out
fields.type: func(ctx context.Context, signature solana.Signature, network string) error

types.name: SettlementCache
types.doc:
SettlementCache is a thread-safe in-memory cache for deduplicating concurrent
settlement requests.  A single instance should be shared across V1 and V2
facilitator scheme instances so that a transaction submitted through one
protocol version is also blocked on the other.

methods.name: Entries
methods.doc: Entries returns a snapshot of the underlying map - use only in tests.

methods.name: IsDuplicate
methods.doc:
IsDuplicate returns true if key is already pending settlement (duplicate).
Otherwise it records the key as newly pending and returns false.
Callers should reject the settlement when this returns true.

methods.name: Mu
methods.doc: Mu returns the mutex - use only in tests.

methods.name: ParsePrice
methods.doc:
ParsePrice parses a price and converts it to an asset amount (V2)
If price is already an AssetAmount, returns it directly.
If price is Money (string | number), parses to decimal and tries custom parsers.
Falls back to default conversion if all custom parsers return nil.

Args:

	price: The price to parse (can be string, number, or AssetAmount map)
	network: The network identifier

Returns:

	AssetAmount with amount, asset, and optional extra fields

GetExtra returns mechanism-specific extra data for the supported kinds endpoint.

Random selection distributes load across multiple signers.

For SVM, returns all available fee payer addresses for the given network.

funcs.name: NewClientSignerFromPrivateKey
funcs.doc:
NewClientSignerFromPrivateKey creates a client signer from a hex-encoded private key.

Args:

	privateKeyHex: Hex-encoded private key (with or without "0x" prefix)

Returns:

	ClientEvmSigner implementation ready for use with evm.NewExactEvmClient()
	Error if private key is invalid

Example:

	signer, err := evm.NewClientSignerFromPrivateKey("0x1234...")
	if err != nil {
	    log.Fatal(err)
	}
	client := x402.Newx402Client().
	    Register("eip155:*", evm.NewExactEvmClient(signer))

funcs.name: NewClientSignerFromPrivateKeyWithClient
funcs.doc:
NewClientSignerFromPrivateKeyWithClient creates a client signer from a private key
and an optional ethclient for contract reads (e.g., querying EIP-2612 nonces).

If ethClient is nil, ReadContract will return an error when called.

types.name: ClientSigner
types.doc:
ClientSigner implements x402evm.ClientEvmSigner using an ECDSA private key.
This provides client-side EIP-712 signing for creating payment payloads.

methods.name: Address
methods.doc: Address returns the Ethereum address of the signer.

methods.name: EstimateFeesPerGas
methods.doc:
EstimateFeesPerGas returns EIP-1559 fee parameters by querying the connected node.
Returns maxFeePerGas and maxPriorityFeePerGas. Falls back to 1 gwei / 0.1 gwei on error.
Requires an ethclient to be provided via NewClientSignerFromPrivateKeyWithClient.
methods.signature: func  EstimateFeesPerGas(ctx context.Context) (maxFeePerGas, maxPriorityFeePerGas *big.Int, err error)

methods.name: GetTransactionCount
methods.doc:
GetTransactionCount returns the pending nonce for the given address.
Requires an ethclient to be provided via NewClientSignerFromPrivateKeyWithClient.
methods.signature: func  GetTransactionCount(ctx context.Context, address string) (uint64, error)

methods.name: HasRPCClient
methods.doc:
HasRPCClient reports whether the signer is backed by an ethclient. When false, its
RPC-dependent methods (ReadContract, GetTransactionCount) are non-functional, so callers
such as evm.ResolveReadSigner fall back to a scheme-configured RPC URL.

methods.name: ReadContract
methods.doc:
ReadContract reads data from a smart contract.
Requires an ethclient to be provided via NewClientSignerFromPrivateKeyWithClient.
methods.signature:
func  ReadContract(
	ctx context.Context,
	contractAddress string,
	abiBytes []byte,
	functionName string,
	args ...interface{},
) (interface{}, error)

methods.name: SignMessage
methods.doc: SignMessage signs a UTF-8 message using the EIP-191 personal-sign format.
methods.signature: func  SignMessage(_ context.Context, message string) (string, error)

methods.name: SignTransaction
methods.doc:
SignTransaction signs an EIP-1559 transaction using the signer's private key
and returns the RLP-encoded signed transaction bytes.

methods.name: SignTypedData
methods.doc:
SignTypedData signs EIP-712 typed data.

Args:

	ctx: Context for cancellation and timeout control
	domain: EIP-712 domain separator
	types: Type definitions for the structured data
	primaryType: The primary type being signed
	message: The message data to sign

Returns:

	65-byte signature (r, s, v)
	Error if signing fails
methods.signature:
func  SignTypedData(
	ctx context.Context,
	domain x402evm.TypedDataDomain,
	types map[string][]x402evm.TypedDataField,
	primaryType string,
	message map[string]interface{},
) ([]byte, error)

funcs.name: NewClientSignerFromPrivateKey
funcs.doc:
NewClientSignerFromPrivateKey creates a client signer from a base58-encoded private key.

Args:

	privateKeyBase58: Base58-encoded Solana private key

Returns:

	ClientSvmSigner implementation ready for use with svm.NewExactSvmClient()
	Error if private key is invalid

Example:

	signer, err := svm.NewClientSignerFromPrivateKey("5J7W...")
	if err != nil {
	    log.Fatal(err)
	}
	client := x402.Newx402Client().
	    Register("solana:*", svm.NewExactSvmClient(signer))

types.name: ResourceServerExtension
types.doc:
ResourceServerExtension is a resource-side extension. Implementations
surface a stable `Key()` plus an enrichment callback used to expand the
extension declaration on the route.

Optional capabilities are exposed via the per-capability interfaces in
`go/server_hooks.go` (e.g. `ResourceServerExtensionHookProvider`,
`ResourceServerExtensionEnrichPaymentRequiredProvider`,
`ResourceServerExtensionEnrichSettleResponseProvider`). The resource
server type-asserts to those interfaces at registration time.
